messages:
maria: Heads-up — scheduled canary for checkout-service v2.1 tonight 00:30 UTC. Low-medium risk (db migration is non-blocking), freeze window 00:15–01:00 UTC. I’ll kick off canary and then handoff at 01:00 UTC. Please pick watchers / rollback owners. :calendar:

devon: noted. I can watch the first 30m (00:30–01:00). Will look at latency and 5xx. Put me as primary watcher. :+1:

ashwin: tagging infra: make sure autoscaler min doesn’t drop during canary — last time we saw a transient OOM. I’ll add a temporary scaling policy: min=2 for checkout-pool.

oncall-bot: Reminder — deploy freeze window set by @maria: 1765009876 00:15–01:00 UTC. Add watchers with `!watch deploy-20260317-23`.

sara: added synthetic checks to Grafana dashboard: checkout_latency_p90, checkout_errors_rate. Alert thresholds: p90 > 400ms or errors > 0.5% -> page. I also wired a quick Kibana query for "checkout:error".

maria: Rollout plan: canary -> 5% (00:30) -> 25% (00:40) -> 100% (00:55) if metrics look good. Rollback trigger: any sustained >1% 5xx over 5m OR p90 >600ms for 3 consecutive windows. Rollback command: `redwood deploy rollback --id=deploy-20260317-checkout-v2.1`

devon: will keep an eye on DB migration stage: it’s a light add-column then backfill via job. Backfill starts at 00:45 and should be low IO. If backfill causes spikes, we rollback.

ashwin: FYI I’ll be out 01:10–01:40 UTC (short window) but reachable on DM if page. If you need me to rollback and I’m not responding, follow the rollback command above — it’s automated and safe for this migration.

maria: handoff plan — I’ll start canary at 00:30, monitor 00:30–01:00. At 01:00 I’ll post final status and handoff to @ashwin for morning follow-up. If anything pages before 01:00, first response = acknowledge, check p90 + 5xx, and run rollback if triggers met.

oncall-bot: Watchers: @devon (primary), @maria (initiator), @ashwin (secondary), @sara (monitoring). PagerDuty policy: checkout-service -> oncall primary.

sara: added a short playbook snippet to the thread for quick troubleshooting:
```
- check grafana: checkout_latency_p90, checkout_errors_rate
- check logs: kibana "checkout:error" since -10m
- verify autoscaler pods: kubectl get hpa -n prod checkout
- run rollback: redwood deploy rollback --id=deploy-20260317-checkout-v2.1
```

maria: thanks all. No extra business logic changes — mostly telemetry and config. I’ll post a quick status update at 00:50 before final rollout. :wave:
